The model generates sequences of words from EEG feature sequences, aiming to match ground-truth word tokens in open-vocabulary settings.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate dataset names (ZuCo v1.0/v2.0) into single 'ZuCo', merged similar output descriptions, and removed redundant task entry
Normalized ROUGE-1 to base ROUGE form according to simplification guidelines
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in the paper; BART is used for generation, not evaluation
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper

overall_notes: The paper focuses on EEG-to-Text generation using a novel CET-MAE model and E2T-PTR framework. Evaluation is done with automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The extraction quality was good overall, mainly needing dataset consolidation and metric normalization.
